description.value:
Despite acting outside of traditional means, rogues are often highly trained experts in their fields. Any less and they could be replaced or worse.

Choose two skills that you are proficient in. Gain expertise in those skills.

See “Chapter 6 - How To Play” for more info on Expertise.

Pick another proficient skill to gain Expertise in when you reach 5th level overall, 11th level overall while at Adept Rogue, and at 17th level overall while at Expert Rogue.

system.requirements: Must have the Rogue Starter Abilities
